title: Statement Delivery Window of the Personal Sender Account
content:
The statement delivery window of a Personal Sender Account statement is a whole number of Paloma business days, Monday to Friday excluding US Federal Reserve holidays.

The standard statement delivery window is the statement delivery time (in Paloma business days) of the level the account holds on the request date. The counted statement window of a statement starts from its standard statement delivery window, and the statement delivery window is the counted statement window.

The delivery due date of a statement is the request date plus the statement delivery window, counted forward in Paloma business days from the request date.

## Reading it as a calculation

| Input | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| Level held | the account record on the request date |
| Statement delivery time of that level | the level's statement entitlements, in Paloma business days |
| Request date | the day the statement is requested |

Output: the statement delivery window in business days, and the delivery due date reached by counting that many Paloma business days forward from the request date.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A statement is requested on a Wednesday by a customer whose level carries a statement delivery time of 3 Paloma business days, in a fortnight with no US Federal Reserve holiday. The statement delivery window is 3 business days: Thursday is day 1, Friday day 2, and the following Monday day 3. The delivery due date is that Monday.

Had the Friday been a US Federal Reserve holiday, it would not be counted, and the delivery due date would be the following Tuesday.
